descriptions: Added menu access per grade — choose which ranks can use the wardrobe and each job stash (Grades & Permissions → Edit Grade).
Added Manage Access per employee — allow or deny one employee the wardrobe, the shop or any single stash right from the Employees tab (new 'Manage access' permission).
Added invoice payouts per grade — bosses set how much of a paid job invoice goes to the employee and how much to the society (requires the latest bablo-billing).
Added Instant Delivery — new creator checkbox that sends store orders straight into the stash.
Added an Enable Shop toggle per job in the creator.
Added a Restore Previous Outfit button in the wardrobe.
Uniforms can now be limited to male or female peds.
Added optional on-duty with uniforms — put on a uniform to clock in, restore your outfit to clock out (QBCore/Qbox, Settings.WardrobeOnDuty).
Added Settings.OutfitProps to choose which accessories count as part of a uniform.
Added Discord and Fivemanage logs for every boss menu action (webhooks.lua).
Added developer events for when the menu opens and closes: bablo-bossmenu:client:onOpen / onClose.
Society balance now updates live while the menu is open, so bank deposits show up without reopening.
The creator is now fully translatable.
Fixed putting on a uniform copying the creator's face, hair and tattoos.
Fixed uniforms changing your own glasses, earrings, watch or bracelets.
Fixed store orders that only partly fit in the stash duplicating the items that arrived.
Job stashes are now locked to their job directly in ox_inventory.
Dashboard and Profile now show the real transaction and store order counts.
No SQL needed — new tables are created automatically.
